significance: Built in 1825 by the merchant Seth Puranmal Ganeriwala with revenue support from the fourth Nizam, this walled 25-acre Rama temple blends Mughal, Rajput and Qutb Shahi forms. Its 20-foot perimeter wall is recorded as having sheltered local people from the Razakars in the late 1940s, and INTACH lists it as a heritage building.
